one_month_reasoning: Reddit's Q3 2026 report is confirmed for Nov 4 2026 AFTER the close, so the earnings reaction lands on Nov 5, outside the window ending at the Nov 4 close. Inside the window: Alphabet and Meta Q3 prints (late Oct) give read-throughs on ad demand (Meta Q2 price/ad +12%) and on Google AI Mode/referral trends; Pinterest/Snap may also report; any news on the expiring Google/OpenAI data-licensing renewal could move the stock 8-10% as in July. Reddit guided Q3 rev $860-870M and street sits at $872M with upward EPS revisions, so pre-print positioning may drift mildly up, but search-traffic data (Similarweb Aug visits -3.2% m/m) offsets. Net: near-symmetric, median ~152.5 with monthly vol ~17-20% (70%/3.5) and slightly fat tails for licensing headlines.

fair_value.method: Blend: 60% P/E (NTM EPS at horizon ~$11.14 from CY27 street $9.69 rolled 75% into CY28 at +20%, haircut 10% to $10.03, x17.5 vs peer median 18.4x = $175.5) and 40% SBC-adjusted FCF yield (2027 owner FCF ~$1.26B at 4.5% + ~$3.0B net cash over 195M shares = $159).

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 $11.14 haircut 10% = $10.03 x 17.5x

inputs_detail.derivation: StockAnalysis consensus; same basis used for all 10 peers. GAAP-basis Yahoo consensus is $7.07 (source 5), so the normalized figure excludes SBC-type items; consistent basis across peers is what matters for the multiple.
Street EPS growth decelerates 69% (2026) to 26% (2027); MAGNA sees social ad growth slowing to single digits from 2027, so assume further deceleration to ~20% in 2028.

57% of reddit.com visits come from organic search; AI Mode refers at 1.6-2.5% vs 17-19% for classic search; Google licensing renewal uncertain; advertiser checks show competing budgets. Haircut to $10.03.
Peer median CY2027 P/E 18.4x (range 7.3x-38.7x); slight discount to median, no premium: higher growth and net cash are offset by search-referral dependence.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: 2027 rev $4.46B x 46% adj EBITDA margin = $2.05B; less ~10% cash tax, ~0 capex = $1.84B; less SBC 13% of rev ($0.58B) = $1.26B owner FCF; /4.5% = $28.0B + $3.0B net cash; /195M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Q3 2026 guide 45% at midpoint; management long-term target 50% via revenue leverage; take 46%.
CFO: SBC low-to-mid teens % of revenue; treated as a real cost.
GAAP net income $252.8M vs adj EBITDA $342.8M in Q2 implies low effective cash tax; assume 10% of EBITDA.
META and GOOGL trade at ~21-23x CY2027 EPS (~4.5% earnings yield); Reddit's higher growth offset by higher risk, so same yield.
$2.77B net cash today plus ~$1B FCF over 12 months less buybacks ($760M authorization remaining).
192.4M outstanding, 207M diluted in Q2; buybacks offset SBC dilution.

bear.story: Google AI Mode keeps cutting referrals, US DAUq declines further, licensing renewal with Google lapses or is cut, 2027 revenue growth falls toward 15-20% and EPS ~20% below street; market pays ~13x reduced EPS plus cash.

base.story: Ad pricing and advertiser growth (+70%) carry revenue ~30% growth in 2027 despite flat US users; margins drift to 46-47%; multiple stays slightly below peer median at ~17.5x NTM EPS.

bull.story: Logged-in user growth re-accelerates (app retention +50%), usage-based licensing deals with Google/OpenAI, revenue beats street toward $4.8B, multiple re-rates to ~22x like GOOGL/META.

comps_summary.peer_range: CY2027 P/E 7.3x-38.7x (10 peers, single basis: StockAnalysis CY2027 street EPS on Oct-5-2026 prices; all calendar fiscal years). Forward EV/EBITDA not collected consistently, left null.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: RDDT trades at 15.7x CY2027 street EPS ($151.69/$9.69), 14.2x ex $14.37/share net cash, i.e. below the 18.4x peer median. We apply 17.5x to horizon NTM EPS after a 10% haircut: inside the range, just under the median.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium: Reddit's EPS growth (+26%) and revenue growth (+32%) exceed the peer median and it has net cash, but 57% of web traffic comes from organic search and AI search refers far fewer clicks, US DAUq fell q/q in Q2, and the Google licensing deal is up for renewal. These risks are why we do not apply a growth premium; a small discount to the median reflects them.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$100 the stock would trade at ~9x CY2027 street EPS ex cash, which would only make sense if the user base were shrinking (US DAUq declining several quarters), revenue growth collapsed toward the ~10% social-ad market rate, or Google cut both referrals and licensing; that is a fundamental break, not volatility.

Renewal terms (or lapse) of Google and OpenAI licensing deals
US logged-in user growth vs international logged-out growth quality
Ad budget competition from TikTok, Snap and AI chatbots (advertiser checks)
Basis gap between normalized ($9.69) and GAAP ($7.07) 2027 EPS consensus
reasoning: Fundamentals are strong (Q2 rev +61%, adj EBITDA margin 43%, Q3 guide +47-49%, $2.8B cash, buybacks at ~$158) yet the stock is -27% y/y because the industry chain is turning against its traffic source: Similarweb shows 57% of visits from organic search and Aug visits -3.2% m/m, AI Mode refers ~2% of queries vs 17-19% for classic search, US DAUq slipped q/q, and Google is renegotiating the licensing deal. Peer read-through on ad demand is healthy (Meta price/ad +12%, impressions +14%; Snap pricing +10%; Pinterest pricing flat) but MAGNA sees social ad growth slowing to single digits from 2027 and advertiser checks point to budget competition. On a consistent CY2027 street-EPS basis RDDT is 15.7x vs a 10-peer median of 18.4x; my blended fair value is ~$169 (P/E $175.5, FCF yield $159), ~11% above spot, below the $214 sell-side mean. Scenarios 95/170/260 at 25/50/25 give mean ~$174; I set a right-skewed distribution with median ~$163-165 and an effective vol of ~55-60% (below 70% realized, which includes event spikes), with fat tails; $14/share net cash limits the extreme downside. One month: earnings fall after the Nov 4 close, outside the window, so near-symmetric at ~19% monthly vol.
